text:
Radhanagar Beach is a beach located on Havelock Island (officially known as Swaraj Dweep), in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India. Recognized for its natural beauty and environmental sustainability, it has been awarded the Blue Flag beach certification, an international eco-label for beaches meeting strict environmental, safety, and cleanliness standards.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Havelock Island (Hindi: हैवलॉक द्वीप, Malayalam: ഹെയ്വ്ലോക് ദ്വീപുകള്‍), known officially as Swaraj Dweep (Island of Freedom), is the most visited of the Andaman Islands. It's becoming popular for its beaches, laid back atmosphere and great scuba diving.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
